title: LA Colossal – Celadon Sanggam 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Mongolian woman in her late 40s, black hair in two long braids, natural face with a gentle smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze clearly covering all skin, fine crackle and soft uneven reflections, black-and-white sanggam lotus ponds and mandarin ducks. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Goryeo style.

Pose: Seated upright on a low wooden bench, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch celadon-glazed platform Mary Jane stilettos with white chrysanthemum buckles.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, celadon with white tips.

Background & Lighting: Korean temple courtyard wall with pine trees (no religious images), softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft daylight with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
